text_en: Liandris, your actions disappoint me. This is the first time I have lost total control of a Valkyrie.
Do not interrupt me, Liandris. You have humiliated me in front of the others.
Is there something I can do?
I can be erased if that is to be my punishment.
No... I want you to find Sangrigor at all costs and bring her before me. I must know why she has escaped my call.
